exposure: TSH concentrations at least 10 mIU/l during the first 3 or 6 months of pregnancy
cohort: Young adult women with CH (n=1158) and a reference group from the French National Perinatal Survey (n=7245)
finding: Congenital hypothyroidism (CH) was associated with an increased risk of gestational hypertension, emergency cesarean delivery, induced labor for vaginal delivery, and prematurity.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery and induced labor for vaginal delivery were higher in the CH group.
